name: OGX
recent: OGX 于 2026 年 10 月 28 日召开第二次常年股东大会及特别股东大会，股东通过以 1900 万令吉收购莎阿南 Bukit Jelutong 仓库物业的议案。公司 2026 财年第四季（截至 8 月 31 日）营收 8551 万令吉，净利 716 万令吉，净利环比增长 90.3%。此外，公司 9 月宣布与 Axtraction 合作提供 AI 解决方案，并进军可再生能源分销业务。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过以 1900 万令吉向 Tristystems Engineering 收购莎阿南 Bukit Jelutong 的仓库物业。
2026 财年第四季净利 716 万令吉，环比增长 90.3%；营收 8551 万令吉，环比增长 46.7%。
公司宣布与 Axtraction 合作提供 AI 解决方案，并进军可再生能源分销业务。
earnings: 2026 财年第四季（截至 8 月 31 日）营收 8551 万令吉，环比增长 46.7%；净利 716 万令吉，环比增长 90.3%；净利率由 6.5% 升至 8.4%。

recent_en: OGX held its 2nd AGM and EGM on 28 October 2026, where shareholders approved the RM19 million acquisition of a warehouse property in Bukit Jelutong, Shah Alam. For 4QFY2026 ended 31 August, revenue was RM85.51 million and net profit RM7.16 million, with net profit up 90.3% QoQ. In September, the company also announced an AI solutions tie-up with Axtraction and a venture into renewable energy distribution.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the RM19 million acquisition of a warehouse property in Bukit Jelutong, Shah Alam from Tristystems Engineering at the EGM.
4QFY2026 net profit was RM7.16 million, up 90.3% QoQ; revenue was RM85.51 million, up 46.7% QoQ.
The company announced an AI solutions partnership with Axtraction and a venture into renewable energy distribution.
earnings_en: For 4QFY2026 ended 31 August, revenue was RM85.51 million, up 46.7% QoQ; net profit was RM7.16 million, up 90.3% QoQ; net margin rose from 6.5% to 8.4%.
